title: Ion Quests
description: A questing mod that allows admin to create quests for players
body: Ion Quests is a Fabric quest book mod for Minecraft 26.1, inspired by FTB Quests. It adds an in-game quest book with chapters, quest nodes, requirements, rewards, locked progression paths, and a built-in admin editor. Players can open quests with the Quest Book item or the G key, and new players receive a Quest Book automatically when they join. Admins can create chapters, add quests, move nodes, link dependencies, set rewards, and build quest progression directly in game. Ion Quests also supports datapack JSON files, making it useful for modpacks that want custom quest lines without editing the mod code.
